application.name: Clustering
application.description: Splits point clouds into objects on the GPU with holoscan-clustering: a synthetic depth camera over boxes and spheres on a removed ground is deprojected by holoscan-point-cloud's DepthToPointCloudOp and clustered by EuclideanClusterOp, every frame checked against the scene's truth, and the clusters shown color-coded with their boxes in HoloViz.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-clustering demo, with a synthetic scene, a ground-truth reporter and a HoloViz view.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

synthetic.description: Cluster 300 frames of the synthetic scene, check each against its truth, and show the clusters with their boxes when a display is available.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic 640x480 frames clustered with a 2.5 cm tolerance; the number of clusters, the adjusted Rand index of the labels, each object's cluster, centroid and box checked against the truth.
